actions.reader_question: What does a 10% to 20% market drop do to my 401(k), and should I sell? [verb-only - no PAA read; ac: 'should i sell my 401k now' completion]
actions.answer: A 10-20% drop leaves 90-80% of the balance and needs an 11.11-25.00% gain to recover; FINRA's turbulent-market guidance stresses goals, diversification and avoiding impulsive moves, and the sell-or-hold choice depends on time horizon, which the page cannot judge (shape: verdict with condition).

actions.reader_question: What would a 10% credit card interest cap save me, and is it law? [verb-only - no PAA read; ac: 'credit card interest cap when does it start']
actions.answer: Not law: S.381 and H.R.1944 are proposals that would cap APRs at 10% until January 2031; on the page's $5,000 example, one 30-day cycle drops from $98.63 at 24% to $41.10 at 10%, a $57.53 difference, if the card stayed available at that rate (shape: figure with condition).
